Not happy with an offer? You can negotiate for better terms. The first offer comes back to you, but it costs a small fee and five more days, and each try costs again, so check the price before you press.

Three prizes are in play: Fastest, On budget and Best built. Win two of the three and the project is yours. If nobody wins two, the lowest total of the three decides. You lose if you run out of money, your design fees pass 20% of the project's scope, or the job runs so long the owner pulls the plug.
